notes.title: Update "Grief like a stray dog" and the Addition of Achievements
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing our game! We carefully read all your feedback and sincerely appreciate the warm reception.

We’re still working on improving the game, so we’d love to hear your feedback and suggestions!

notes.title: Announcement: Release Date for "Grief like a Stray Dog"
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that our game "Grief like a Stray Dog" will be released on January 29, 2025.  

We are also thrilled to present our new trailer!

[previewyoutube=9aNofnAN2Sw;full][/previewyoutube]

An Interactive Narrative of Loss and Resilience

"Grief like a Stray Dog" is an interactive play that combines elements of a visual novel and an adventure game. The story unfolds in a small village behind the front lines during World War II. The player will immerse themselves in the story of young Nadia, who, stepping in for her sick mother, becomes a postwoman delivering news from the front. Among the letters are not only words of hope but also tragic notifications.

Availability 
The game supports controller input (Xbox) and will be available in both Russian and English. The game’s translation into other languages is in development.

About Our Team
Rayonist is an independent studio that creates games with memorable artistic solutions, deep storylines, and a unique atmosphere.
